independent_reviewer_counterclaim: A reviewer could say this session is the pathology it diagnoses. It was commissioned to walk the pipeline and author one cell; it authored none, added a 791-line governance document that nothing reads, and closed with more open owner-gated questions than it opened with. Thirty-three commits and zero rows of evidence. The stronger form: the map is descriptive, self-declares that no code consumes it, and hardcodes volatile facts that CLAUDE.md section 2b says will drift — so by the repository's own doctrine it is prose about the machine rather than machine, and prose about the machine is what D-2 says must never be the body. The counter is that the cull removed 6,716 lines against 791 added, and that BRK-20 and BRK-26 are defects in the write path the next determination would have used, so the walk did carry something back. But a reviewer is entitled to answer that a map which nothing reads is a plan for a sequencer, not a sequencer, and that this project has never been short of plans.
